products.name: Attack Surface Reduction (ASR) Rules — Commercial
products.short_description: Block the behaviors malware relies on — Audit-first so nothing breaks. Deploy ASR yourself with self-guided, tested steps for far less than consulting.
products.description:
Behavior-based malware prevention — without breaking your apps

Most malware uses the same handful of tricks: a macro spawning PowerShell, an attachment launching an executable, credential theft from LSASS. Attack Surface Reduction rules block those behaviors at the source — and rolled out Audit-first, you see exactly what would be blocked, add exclusions for legitimate apps, then enforce with total confidence.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant on site to deploy Attack Surface Reduction (ASR) Rules. This package hands you the exact, field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation that a non-expert administrator can follow from start to finish — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell scripts that do the heavy lifting. You implement with confidence, on your own schedule, and keep the playbook forever.

  • Simpler — exact navigation in the right order, written for a novice admin. Click to implement; the “why” lives in the overview so the steps stay short and uncluttered.
  • Cheaper — one fixed, transparent price instead of an open meter. A comparable consulting engagement runs $1,500–$3,000 per day across several days; this is a fraction of that, with nothing left to bill.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with validation scripts and clear pass/fail gates, so you know it worked before you roll out to the fleet.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — what ASR rules block and how Audit/Block modes work.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite with verify/implement steps.
  • Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: Audit → review → exclude → Block.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — posture discovery, rule validation, audit-event reporting, remediation, and a GUID→name rule reference.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with pass/fail gates, plus Best Practices.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each one you deploy feels familiar and low-risk — and your team gets faster and more confident with every rollout. Buy once, deploy to unlimited devices, and reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Whole classes of attack blocked at the behavior level — Office child processes, LSASS credential theft, malicious email payloads, obfuscated scripts, ransomware — rolled out without breaking a single line-of-business app.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • ASR-AuditReport.ps1 — summarize local Defender ASR audit/block events
    • ASR-Discovery.ps1 — Defender AV state and current ASR rule configuration
    • ASR-Remediation.ps1 — ensure Defender AV is active and force a policy sync so ASR applies
    • ASR-RuleReference.ps1 — print the ASR rule GUID → friendly-name reference, with this device's state
    • ASR-Validation.ps1 — confirm the high-value ASR rules are configured in the expected mode

Delivered as a branded Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse across unlimited devices.
